clues: Of Otis and Faye, one stopped by at 5:00 p.m. and the other at 6:30 p.m.
Of the visitor with the purple pen and the one who came at 5:30 p.m., one brought pretzels and the other brought almonds.
Whoever brought the almonds stopped by earlier than whoever brought the grapes.
Tariq and the visitor with the black pen were two different people: one brought grapes, the other pretzels.
The 6:00 p.m. visitor had either the blue pen or the green pen.
Whoever brought popcorn stopped by at either 5:30 p.m. or 6:30 p.m.
The 5:30 p.m. visitor, the one with almonds, the one with grapes, Otis, and the one with the blue pen were five different people.
Wren stopped by later than the visitor who brought grapes.
hints: Look at the grapes in the box where snacks meet times. Which times could the grapes possibly have?
Comparisons rule out the ends. Apply clues 3 and 8 to the grapes, then see which time clue 7 takes away.
So the grapes came at 6:00 or 6:30, and Wren later (clue 8). Clue 1 gives 6:30 to Otis or Faye, so Wren came at 7:00.
By clue 2, the 5:30 visitor brought pretzels or almonds, so clue 6 puts the popcorn at 6:30. The grapes came at 6:00.

solution.key_idea: Clues 3, 7 and 8 leave the grapes only 6:00 or 6:30, so Wren came at 7:00: clue 1 gives 6:30 to Otis or Faye.
steps: Clue 3 keeps the grapes off 5:00, clue 7 off 5:30, and clue 8 off 7:00. So the grapes came at 6:00 or 6:30.
By clue 8, Wren came after 6:00. Clue 1 gives 6:30 to Otis or Faye, so Wren came at 7:00.
By clue 2, the 5:30 visitor brought pretzels or almonds, so clue 6 puts the popcorn at 6:30. The grapes came at 6:00.
Clues 7 and 3 put the almonds at 5:00. By clue 2, the 5:30 snack was pretzels, so Wren's 7:00 snack was fudge.
By clue 5, the 6:00 visitor had blue or green; clue 7 keeps blue from the grapes. So the visitor with the grapes had green.
Clue 7 keeps Otis from the 5:00 almonds, so by clue 1 Otis came at 6:30 with popcorn, and Faye at 5:00 with almonds.
By clue 2, the visitor with the purple pen brought pretzels or almonds, but did not come at 5:30. So Faye had purple, and clue 7 leaves blue for Wren.
Green went with the grapes, so by clue 4 Tariq had both, and the black pen's owner brought pretzels. Otis had popcorn, so Emil had black, Otis red.
solution.epilogue: Tariq mistook the proof for a spare copy and corrected three answers he was sure were wrong, in green ink. Ada changed them back and gave him a crossword of his own.

answer_line: Tariq scrambled the crossword with the green pen.
